newsitem.title: USA: U.S Midco product diffs steady to lower late Tues.
newsitem.headline: U.S Midco product diffs steady to lower late Tues.

text.p: U.S. midcontinent products diffs were steady to lower Tuesday with players seeing tightness tomorrow after new data from American Petroleum Institute (API) showed a fall in regional gasoline.
"I would imagine Chicago will come up pretty sharply tomorrow," a trader said.
Midwest (PADD 2) gasoline stocks fell 1.6 million barrels last week to stand 51.3 million for the week ended April 18.
Differentials for unleaded gasoline in Chicago eased from morning levels, down 0.25 cents a gallon to stand 0.50 to 0.25 cents a gallon below the May unleaded gasoline contract.
In Group Three, prompt unleaded gasoline was pegged at between 0.75 and 0.50 cent under May futures, flat from earlier, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel was offered in the Group at 6.00 cents over and at a slightly weaker 2.75 cents over May futures in Chicago.
"(Diesel differentials) were pretty much stable to lower," a trader said, noting agricultural demand hasn't picked up in all parts of the country.
